verdict.rationale: ReelMimic plans a whole multi-shot video up front with a storyboard, defined characters, assets and style frames (docs-3). The Production line tracks each character across the video (gh-2), and user-supplied character designs are followed (docs-11), which implies shared character and scene definitions carry across shots. However, no evidence explicitly claims or demonstrates that characters or scenes stay visually consistent from shot to shot, and per-shot review (docs-4) is not stated to check cross-shot consistency. missing for 10: an explicit cross-shot character/scene consistency guarantee or mechanism, a consistency check in the review step, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
